note: Indiana DNR Division of Forestry, Yellowwood State Forest. Primitive drive-in sites in four areas beside 133-acre Yellowwood Lake, with short paths down to the water; sites sit back above the shore, not at the water's edge. (Carry-in tent area and horseman's camp excluded.) --Claude
summary: $12-12.15 fee table confirmed; FCFS 365 days confirmed, so year-round added; site count 79->77 per the forest map's named loops (page says 80); vault toilets and water added; note-derived dump cleared (no DNR page names one). Not waterfront stands with one lead.
flags: PHONE missing: forest office 812-988-7945, 772 Yellowwood Lake Road (forest page). apply.py doesn't write phone.

WATER LEAD: I plotted the loops on imagery (leaf-off, gravel loops visible). Red Pine (30 sites) is the closest: its west tip sits about 20-30 m from the lake, the rest 40-100 m, with a wooded bank all the way around; no open apron. Redbud, White Oak-Hickory and Black Gum are further back. Not waterfront stands on the stored rule, but a Red Pine '*view' at leaf-off is the question to look at; satellite can't show the pads at the tip under the trees.
PIN: 39.1816,-86.3379 falls in woods between the sections, on the arm's head, not in a loop, but within about 150 m of the middle of the four. No move.

FIT: no DNR page gives a site length or rig limit, and neither mentions the note's 'gravel pads', so that went from the note. The loops read as vehicle loops on imagery. No review naming a rig read: the Google query returned several listings (4.8/31, 4.7/1,158) and I read none, so nothing quoted.

ALERT: the page's closure is trail only: 'the Tecumseh Trail is closed at the section shown on the map until further notice'; campground not affected. 'Camping is not permitted at these two lakes' means Bear and Crooked Creek lakes, not Yellowwood; 'swimming is not permitted at any lake'. Horse camp stays excluded: page says 10 sites, map 12.
DUMP: 'One dump station' was in the old note with no source. Neither the forest page nor the map names one, so cleared; if AWH knows otherwise it can return.
